task: Design and evaluate Kolmogorov–Arnold Graph Neural Networks (KA-GNNs) for molecular property prediction
primary_objective: Predict molecular properties from graph-structured molecules using atom-level and bond-level features
Compare KA-inspired Fourier transformations against conventional MLP graph baselines
Assess predictive accuracy, computational efficiency, and interpretability
named_method_commitments: Graph neural network for molecular property prediction
Kolmogorov–Arnold style replacement of MLP transformations with Fourier-based modules
Use both covalent and non-covalent interaction information when building graph representations where feasible from available SMILES-derived structure
Include interpretability artifacts, not only accuracy metrics
expected_outputs: Interpretability artifact comparing learned feature importance or sensitivity
Validation section separating direct evidence from assumptions
likely_limitations: Only SMILES are provided; true 3D non-covalent interactions may need approximation rather than experimentally resolved geometry
Exact KA-GNN architecture from related work may require adaptation to available libraries and time budget
